items.title: Emile Barnes Interview, 1960-08-22
items.q: The name 'Meyer' is mentioned by the Interviewer in a conversational aside ('take a look at the joint on that, Meyer') and the Interviewee does not respond to or acknowledge this mention, nor does the Interviewee mention Meyer in their own turns.

ctx.x: Yeah, but how many I really couldn't tell you, but I know that he played with the band with it. And I know the band didn't play in one key. So it must have been right, it must have been equalized to a C. Yeah. That's a way too. Yeah, it's quite heavy. Maybe that metal head on the biggolone. Yeah. It's really strong. Yeah, it's probably pretty old, probably 40 or 50 or more than 40 I'd say.

Speaking about the way they make things, take a look at the joint on that, Meyer. It comes, I think there's either one or two joints there. Just pull it apart and you'll see. Oh, it just slips apart. Yeah. Oh.
That's the way you tune it there.
